title: The Loneliest Man in Town (KINO)
synopsis:
Blues musician Al Cook lives surrounded by memories: his Viennese apartment crammed with vinyl records, videotapes, and a lifetime of devotion to a music he loves from an ocean away. When a ruthless real estate company targets his home for demolition, he must let go of his treasures one by one and face a radical new beginning.

 

From award-winning Austrian duo Tizza Covi and Rainer Frimmel, this quietly moving and unexpectedly funny portrait of loss and passion blurs the line between reality and fiction, bringing a real-life bluesman to the screen through non-professional performance and the warm, grainy textures of Super 16mm film. Premiered in competition at the Berlinale 2026.

 

Supported by Austrian Consulate General Hong Kong
